description: Option-type utility atoms encoded as i64-tagged values (0 = None, 1 = Some) with companion payload helpers. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/option — verified Option utilities'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm already uses (checked_add, checked_sub, conditional expressions, comparisons).

atoms.name: option_some
atoms.description: Construct the Some tag (encoded as 1) for any payload value.

atoms.name: option_is_some
atoms.description: Test whether an Option-tag value is the Some variant. Encoded values are restricted to 0 or 1 by the precondition.

atoms.name: option_unwrap_or
atoms.description: Project an Option to its payload, falling back to a default when the tag is None. Branches on the tag predicate so the caller never observes an undefined value.
